title: Pure identity-slice evaluation detects tensor-to-Hom maps
statement: Let (C,J) be a site and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Work in a common module universe containing both site universes, assume module sheafification exists with the locally bijective criterion, and assume its localization class is monoidal. For sheaves of R-modules A,B,P,N and morphisms f,g from A tensor B to internal Hom(P,N), suppose that for every object U and local sections v of A, z of B, x of P, evaluation of f(v tensor z) and g(v tensor z) on x at the identity slice of U agrees. Then f=g. The tensor is the existing sheafified tensor and the internal Hom is the existing sheaf of morphisms on slices. The tensor and internal Hom are [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and [def-pur-sheaf-hom].

source.place: paragraph 1, finite-free coefficient construction: uniqueness of the homogeneous evaluation formula; Stacks Tags 03EK and 03EO

proof.text: Cancel the inverse tensor/sheafification comparison and apply the sheafification Hom adjunction. Equality is reduced to presheaf maps from the sectionwise tensor into the internal Hom presheaf.

For presheaf maps into the slice internal Hom, naturality along W→U identifies a slice component over W with identity-slice evaluation of the restricted source section. Thus evaluations at all identity slices determine the entire presheaf map.
Use induction on the presheaf tensor. The pure-tensor case is the hypothesis; zero and sum cases follow from additivity of the maps and of evaluation.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 1; universal-property uniqueness proof formalized by G7

mathlib_searches.query: Morphisms from the tensor product of sheaves of modules to an internal Hom are equal if their values on pure tensors agree after evaluation on every local section
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: module tensor_ext₃ and general sheaf/presheaf hom_ext lemmas, but no identity-slice criterion for sheaf tensor-to-internal-Hom maps.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The general extensionality APIs do not state the needed sheafification and identity-slice criterion.
This covers module tensors; the sheafification and internal-Hom naturality steps still require a proof.

mathlib_searches.results: No matches in Mathlib. The sheafified tensor and slice-Hom APIs are in the adopted source library.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Prove this criterion from the adopted definitions and tensor induction.

      (f.val.app U ((SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A B).inv.val.app U

          (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R₁).obj)).unit.app

              (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U.unop))) x =
      (g.val.app U ((SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A B).inv.val.app U
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction.{max c v r}
          (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R₁).obj)).unit.app
            (A.val ⊗ B.val)).app U (v ⊗ₜ[R₁.obj.obj U] z)))).app
